dataset_title: Series production data set for 5-axis CNC milling
machine: HERMLE C600 U five-axis milling machine
integration_status: standalone real source; not yet joined to other project datasets
limitations: ERP production-order IDs are not public.
Planned order quantity, due date, customer, BOM, routing and unit cost are not public.
Some sessions have 19 NC features because PocketTable was not recorded.
Only sessions 1, 2 and 13 have all detailed phase labels; sessions 3-12 primarily provide the two-phase production/changeover label.
